title: Driver app v2 beta feedback
body:
Hi,

Summary of beta feedback from 25 drivers on the v2 driver mobile app:

- 80% prefer the new turn-by-turn navigation
- Several reports of the app freezing when switching to offline mode
- Drivers want a bigger "Delivered" button for use with gloves

I've filed the offline-mode crash as an issue in Linear. Let's prioritize it before the wider rollout.

Thanks,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
